name: Masgouf
steps: Cut the fish open and clean it
Season the fish with salt and tamarind sauce
Place the fish near an open fire

name: Yaprax Dolma
steps: Wash the grape leaves and remove the stems
Mix rice, minced meat, chopped onion, garlic, and parsley in a bowl
Add salt, pepper and olive oil to the mixture.
Place a spoonful of the filling on each grape leaf
Fold the sides and roll tightly into small wraps.
Place the rolls in a pot and add a little water and lemon juice.
Cook on low heat until the rice is fully cooked.

name: Kubba
steps: Soak the bulgur in water until soft.
Mix bulgur with flour and salt to form a dough.
Cook minced meat with onion, parsley and pine nuts.
Season the filling with salt and black pepper.
Shape the dough into small shells.
Fill the shells with the meat mixture and seal them.
Deep fry the kubba until golden brown.

name: Tashreeb
steps: Cook lamb with onion and garlic in a large pot.
Add tomatoes and potatoes to the lamb stew.
Season with cumin, salt and black pepper.
Simmer until the meat becomes tender.
Break flatbread into pieces in a bowl.
Pour the hot stew over the bread and let it soak before eating.

name: Tepsi Baytinijan
steps: Fry the eggplant lightly in oil
Cook minced meat with onion and garlic.
Layer eggplant and potatoes in a baking tray.
Add the meat mixture on top.
Bake in the oven until fully cooked.

name: Iraqi Biryani
steps: Wash and partially cook the rice.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic in a large pot.
Mix the rice with the chicken mixture.
Cook everything together until flavors combine.

name: Bamia
steps: Heat oil in a pot and cook onion until soft.
Add lamb and cook until browned.
Mix in tomato paste and spices.
Add water and simmer until the meat is tender.
Add okra and cook until soft.

name: Samoon Sandwich
steps: Cook the chicken with salt and pepper.
Add lettuce, tomato, and onion inside the samoon bread.
Place the cooked chicken on top.

name: Mutabbaq Samak
steps: Season the fish with salt and spices.
Cook rice in a separate pot, add turmeric powder to make the rice yellow.
Saute onion and garlic in oil.
Mix rice with the onion mixture.
Serve the fish on top of the yellow rice.

name: Lentil Soup
steps: Heat oil and cook onion until soft.
Mix in tomato paste and spices.
Add water and simmer until lentils are soft.

name: Doner Kebab
steps: Marinate beef with yogurt, garlic and spices.

name: Iskender Kebab
steps: Cut pita bread into small pieces.
Add slices of doner meat on top.
Pour tomato sauce over the meat.

name: Lahmacun
steps: Prepare a mixture of minced meat, tomato and onion.
Bake in a hot oven until cooked.

name: Gozleme
steps: Roll the dough into a thin flatbread.
Add spinach, cheese and onion filling.
Fold the dough over the filling.
Cook on a hot pan with oil.
Cook until both sides are golden.

name: Menemen
steps: Cook onion and green pepper in butter.
Stir gently until eggs are cooked.

name: Pide
steps: Roll the dough into a boat shape.
Add minced meat and chopped vegetables.
Bake in the oven until the dough is golden.
Crack an egg on top if desired.

name: Kofte
steps: Mix minced meat with onion, garlic and parsley.
Shape the mixture into small patties.
Cook on a grill or pan.

name: Manti
steps: Prepare small dumplings filled with minced beef and onion.
Boil the dumplings in salted water until cooked.
Place the dumplings on a plate and add yogurt sauce.
Heat butter with paprika and pour on top.

name: Imam Bayildi
steps: Cut eggplants in half and fry lightly in olive oil.
Cook onion, garlic and tomatoes in a pan.
Fill the eggplants with the tomato mixture.
Bake in the oven until soft.

name: Simit
steps: Mix flour, yeast, water and salt to make dough.
Dip the rings into water and sesame seeds.
Bake in the oven until golden brown.

name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Spread tomato sauce on the dough.
Bake in a hot oven until the crust is golden.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Cook minced beef with onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes and simmer to make sauce.

name: Lasagna
steps: Cook minced beef with onion and garlic.
Layer pasta sheets with meat sauce and bechamel.
Bake in the oven until golden.

name: Fettuccine Alfredo
steps: Melt butter and add cream in a pan.
Mix the pasta with the creamy sauce.

name: Risotto
steps: Cook onion in butter and olive oil.
Slowly add vegetable broth while stirring.

name: Gnocchi
steps: Mix potatoes with flour and egg to form dough.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Combine pasta with bacon and egg mixture.

name: Ravioli
steps: Fill with ricotta and spinach mixture.
Serve with tomato sauce and parmesan.

name: Italian Grilled Chicken Pasta
steps: Prepare cream sauce with garlic and parmesan.
Add sliced grilled chicken on top.

name: Banana Smoothie
steps: Add banana, milk and honey into a blender.

name: Chocolate Milkshake
steps: Add milk, chocolate and ice cream to a blender.

name: Pancakes
steps: Mix flour, milk and eggs to make batter.
Cook until both sides are golden.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in oil.
Add tomatoes and spices to make sauce.
Add chicken and cook until tender.

name: Vegetable Biryani
ingredients: biryani spices (also add cardamom, cinammon, and cloves after the rice)
steps: Boil rice in plently of salt water .
Cook vegetables with onion and spices.

name: Palak Paneer
steps: Cook spinach and blend into puree.
Cook onion, garlic and ginger in oil.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Cook onion, garlic and tomato in oil.
Heat butter with cumin and pour over dal.

name: Naan Bread
steps: Mix flour, yeast and yogurt to form dough.
Cook in a hot pan or oven.

name: Samosa
steps: Cook potatoes with peas and spices.
Prepare dough and shape into triangles.

name: Tandoori Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices.
Let it rest for at least one hour.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Cook onion and tomato in butter.

name: Sushi
steps: Slice and serve with soy sauce.

name: Ramen
steps: Pour broth and add egg and green onion.

name: Pad Thai
steps: Top with peanuts and bean sprouts.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Cook garlic and vegetables in oil.

name: Teriyaki Chicken
steps: Add soy sauce, sugar, garlic and ginger.

name: Asian Dumplings
steps: Mix minced pork, cabbage, onion, garlic and ginger.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Bulgogi
steps: Mix soy sauce, sugar, garlic and sesame oil.
Cook beef in a hot pan.

name: Pho
steps: Heat broth with onion and ginger.
Top with green onion and lime.

name: Tofu Stir Fry
steps: Cook tofu in a pan until golden.

name: Tourtiere
steps: Cook pork with onion and spices.

name: Bannock
steps: Mix flour, baking powder and salt.
Cook in a pan until golden.

name: Nanaimo Bars
steps: Mix graham crackers, cocoa and butter.

name: Maple Salmon
steps: Season salmon with salt and pepper.
Mix maple syrup, soy sauce and garlic.

name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
steps: Add strawberries and banana to a blender.

name: Mango Smoothie
steps: Add mango and banana to blender.

name: Chocolate Banana Smoothie
steps: Add banana and milk to blender.
Add cocoa powder and peanut butter.

name: Green Detox Smoothie
steps: Add spinach and cucumber to blender.

name: Berry Blast Smoothie
steps: Add mixed berries and banana to blender.

name: Peanut Butter Protein Smoothie
steps: Add banana and milk to blender.

name: Tropical Smoothie
steps: Add mango, pineapple and banana to blender.
Add ice and blend until smooth.

name: Cheesecake
steps: Crush biscuits and mix with butter.
Mix cream cheese, sugar and eggs.

name: Apple Pie
steps: Slice apples and mix with sugar and cinnamon.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait
steps: Add a layer of greek yogurt to a glass.
Repeat layers and drizzle honey on top.

name: Chocolate Protein Mug Cake
steps: Mix oat flour, cocoa powder, and protein powder in a mug.
Stir well and microwave for 60 to 90 seconds.

name: Cottage Cheese Chocolate Mousse
steps: Add cottage cheese, cocoa powder, honey, vanilla, and milk to a blender.

name: Almond Butter Banana Ice Cream
steps: Blend frozen bananas with almond butter, milk, and vanilla.
Stir in chocolate chips and serve.

name: Peanut Butter Greek Yogurt Bites
steps: Mix greek yogurt, peanut butter, honey, and oats.
Scoop small portions onto a tray.

name: High Protein Cheesecake Cups
steps: Crush oats and press them into small cups.
Mix greek yogurt, cream cheese, and honey.
Add mixture on top of oats and garnish with berries.

name: Protein Brownies
steps: Mix with almond butter, cocoa powder, and protein powder.

name: Chocolate Chip Banana Oatmeal Cookies
steps: Mash banana and mix with oats and peanut butter.
Scoop onto baking tray and bake for 12 minutes at 180°C.

name: Strawberry Yogurt Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend greek yogurt, strawberries, and banana.
Top with granola, almonds, and honey.

name: Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups
steps: Add peanut butter mixture and cover with more chocolate.

name: Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
steps: Mix chia seeds with coconut milk and honey.
Top with fresh mango before serving.

name: Apple Cinnamon Protein Oat Bake
steps: Mix oats, milk, protein powder, cinnamon, and honey.

name: Date Peanut Butter Energy Balls
steps: Blend dates, peanut butter, oats, almonds, and cocoa powder.
